name: STOCK_ELIGIBILITY_V1
candidate_rule: A Spare Part Unit is Stock-eligible only when current physical projection says serviceable/new-compatible disposition is available, no active Task allocation exists, no accepted installed relationship is current, no open return obligation/Fault Tag ownership conflicts, and no quarantine/scrap/dismantled/returned state applies.
compatibility: exact accepted BOM compatibility is highest-confidence candidate evidence
serial equality is duplicate/reconciliation evidence only and never compatibility identity
Device/Model/Installed Component compatibility may be consumed from explicit future LLD-08 interface when available; absent or indeterminate compatibility is shown as unknown and never auto-reserved
operator may deliberately request externally even when compatible Stock exists
query_plan: use indexed spare_part_current_projection disposition/condition and BOM key first
exclude active task_unit_allocation_current and current return/installed conflicts through indexed anti-joins
paginate deterministic by compatibility class then LSU/display/internal id
mutation_rule: A read suggestion never writes reservation, Need resolution or Task state. Reservation revalidates eligibility inside UnitOfWork.
